findings.description: The function's environment block embeds a literal AWS access key ID and secret access key, so the long-lived credentials are stored in Terraform state, in the Lambda console/API, and in any snapshot of this configuration; anyone with read access to the function or state file can exfiltrate them.

No kms_key_arn is set on the environment block, so the plaintext secrets above are only protected by the default service-managed key and are readable by any principal with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration permission.
The function runs on nodejs12.x, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, leaving known-vulnerable runtime code exposed for an attacker to exploit.
